name: 100x-video-reverse
author: 100x
summary: Local source video in; validated evidence and machine package plus a Chinese operator review with a narrow portrait player, fixed first/highlight/end segment triptychs, draggable JPEG previews, original-frame path fallback and owning-segment prompts. Analysis only: no generation, publishing or automatic upload.

supersedes.reason: Version 2.3 keeps the v2.1 machine Schema and v2.2 digest compatibility while improving the deterministic Chinese operator projection, segment triptychs and image drag handoff.

validation.structural: schema.json is JSON Schema draft-07 and is compiled by ajv in scripts/validate.js. It validates required fields, types, minimum content and nested package shape.
validation.cross_item: scripts/validate.js checks timeline continuity, duration arithmetic, unique and resolvable shot/asset references, segment and execution-plan references, ready-state completeness, confidence ranges and safe relative media paths. Its --selftest uses synthetic fixtures only.
validation.filesystem_and_provenance: scripts/validate_reverse_package.py performs the full handoff gate against reverse.json, source_manifest.json, materialized files and materialization_manifest.json. It hard-stops when jsonschema is unavailable and does not treat legacy media as valid for a new handoff.
validation.presentation: scripts/digest.py deterministically projects validated packages to Markdown or self-contained Codex fragments. The fragment fixes three first/highlight/end slots per segment, localizes operator labels, exposes English prompts on demand and supplies draggable JPEG previews plus original-frame paths. Its UI does not modify reverse.json, validation.json or materialized media.

optional: a user-selected output directory; otherwise use the workspace default
explicit authorization for an external multimodal model
a user-selected target generation model for prompt adaptation

requires_data_note: The public skill contains no customer corpus, account identifier, product name, video frame or private benchmark input. Runtime evidence is created from the user's local video and remains outside this repository.

language_scope.observed_audio_and_text: Preserve the source language exactly when legible or audible; otherwise record uncertainty instead of inventing content.
language_scope.generation_prompts: Model-neutral common prompt plus currently verified model adapters.

eval_policy: evals/ contains only synthetic reverse.json structures. Real videos, frames, transcripts, customer names, account names, product names and credentials are prohibited.
